records.text: An unnamed commenter speculated that the Macrons' lawsuit was supposed to go nowhere because Candace Owens was supposed to be assassinated before the case reached court, after which opponents could claim she had lied.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep a-e7HC6SeK8)

appearances.snippet: "I believe that the purpose of Macron's (Emmanuel Macron's) lawsuit was that it was supposed to go nowhere because Candace (Candace Owens) was supposed to have been assassinated before the case got to court." Then they could forever claim that Candace was lying, which is evident by the fact that they were suing her for, quote-unquote, "defamation," before someone had killed her. "This was their plan, but I pray that it has now been foiled."
